sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园里发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，且体内的血已被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但确认她的身份后，这起离奇的谋杀案反而变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是“档案档案呈献”推出全新系列，您现在可以在各大播客平台收听。

sentences.en: Please see the show notes for this episode on your app or on our website.
sentences.zh: 请在您的应用程序上或我们的网站上查看本集的节目简介。

sentences.en: Today's episode involves crimes against children and won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目涉及针对儿童的犯罪，并非所有听众都适合收听。

sentences.en: Please note that the names of several individuals have been changed due to court suppression orders
sentences.zh: 请注意，由于法院的压制令，为了防止几名涉案人员被认出，他们的名字已被更改；

sentences.en: preventing them from being identified, while others have been changed to protect their privacy.
sentences.zh: 同时，其他人的名字也被更改以保护他们的隐私。

sentences.en: It was 10.50 on the morning of Friday, September 12, 2014, when a call came through to the New South Wales Police Emergency Helpline.
sentences.zh: 那是2014年9月12日星期五上午10点50分，新南威尔士州警察紧急求助热线接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: On the other line was a woman named Angela, calling from the small hinterland town of Kandor, located on the state's mid-north coaSt.
sentences.zh: 电话那头是一位名叫安吉拉（Angela）的女士，她打自该州中北部海岸的小内陆镇坎多尔（Kandor）。

sentences.en: Police Emergency, this is Simone.
sentences.zh: 警察紧急求助中心，我是西蒙妮。

sentences.en: Yeah, hi, my son is me, I think it's three and a half.
sentences.zh: 对，你好，我的儿子，我想他三岁半了。

sentences.en: Um, sorry?
sentences.zh: 嗯，不好意思？

sentences.en: Your address?
sentences.zh: 你的地址是？

sentences.en: Benhamoon Drive.
sentences.zh: 本哈蒙路。

sentences.en: Kendal.
sentences.zh: 肯达尔。

sentences.en: Okay, Benhamoon Drive in Kendal?
sentences.zh: 好的，肯达尔的本哈蒙路？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Alright, I'm just going to bring that up on my map, I won't be a moment.
sentences.zh: 好的，我这就把它调到我的地图上，请稍等。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: How long has he been missing?
sentences.zh: 他失踪多久了？

sentences.en: Well, I think, well, we've been looking for him now for about 15 or 20 minutes, but...
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想，呃，我们找他大概有15或20分钟了，但是……

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I thought it could be five, it could be longer, because he's just playing around here, we heard him and then we heard nothing.
sentences.zh: 我觉得可能是5分钟，也可能更久，因为他刚才就在这里玩，我们听见他声音，然后就没声音了。

sentences.en: Okay, so I've got the nearest cost rate being Ellendale Crescent, is that right?
sentences.zh: 好的，我查到的最近的交叉路口是埃伦代尔新月街，对吗？

sentences.en: So, what is it?
sentences.zh: 所以，是什么？

sentences.en: Ellendale Crescent?
sentences.zh: 埃伦代尔新月街？

sentences.en: I don't know, this is my mum's house.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，这是我妈妈的房子。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Um...
So, he's been missing since about 10.30?
sentences.zh: 所以，他大约从10点30分开始失踪的？

sentences.en: Yeah, I'd say so.
sentences.zh: 对，我估摸着是。

sentences.en: Okay, can you describe him to me?
sentences.zh: 好的，你能描述一下他的外貌吗？

sentences.en: How tall?
sentences.zh: 多高？

sentences.en: Obviously not very tall.
sentences.zh: 显然不会太高。

sentences.en: No, he's been about two and a half feet.
sentences.zh: 对，他大概两英尺半高。

sentences.en: He's wearing a Spider-Man outfit.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一套蜘蛛侠衣服。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: What colour hair has he got?
sentences.zh: 他是什么颜色的头发？

sentences.en: He's got dark, sandy coloured hair, it's short, and he's got really big, brownie-drain coloured eyes.
sentences.zh: 他留着深沙色的短发，眼睛是非常大的、带点棕红色的眼睛。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: What do you get in these shoes on?
sentences.zh: 他穿着什么鞋子？

sentences.en: Do you know any other distinguishing features?
sentences.zh: 你知道他有什么其他明显的特征吗？

sentences.en: He has...
sentences.zh: 他有……

sentences.en: Oh, he's got a freckle on the top of his head when he part the hair on the left-hand side.
sentences.zh: 哦，他左边分头缝的时候，头顶上有一颗雀斑。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: You'll see a freckle on the top of his head.
sentences.zh: 你会看到他头顶上有一颗雀斑。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 行。

sentences.en: Do you know where he might have gone?
sentences.zh: 你知道他可能会去哪里吗？

sentences.en: Um, we actually live...
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们其实住在……

sentences.en: Well, Mum's property is near a state foreSt.
sentences.zh: 呃，妈妈的房产靠近一个州立森林。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And they're on a huge block.
sentences.zh: 而且他们在一块很大的地皮上。

sentences.en: We've walked up and down Benaroon Drive and we can't find him.
sentences.zh: 我们沿着本鲁恩路来回找过了，但找不到他。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: What's his name?
sentences.zh: 他叫什么名字？

sentences.en: William.
sentences.zh: 威廉。

sentences.en: What's William's surname?
sentences.zh: 威廉的姓是什么？

sentences.en: Uh, T-Y-R-R-E-L-L.
sentences.zh: 呃，T-Y-R-R-E-L-L。

sentences.en: Senior Constable Christopher Rowley was already in the area when he received word of the missing three-year-old boy in Kendall.
sentences.zh: 高级警员克里斯托弗·罗利（Christopher Rowley）在肯达尔接到三岁男孩失踪的消息时，已经在该地区了。

sentences.en: He arrived at Benaroon Drive at 11.06am, by which time William Tyrrell had reportedly been missing for just over half an hour.
sentences.zh: 他在上午11点06分抵达本鲁恩路，当时威廉·泰雷尔（William Tyrrell）据报已经失踪刚满半小时。

sentences.en: The single-storey brick home of William's grandmother,
sentences.zh: 威廉的祖母玛丽·桑德斯（Mary Saunders）的单层砖房

sentences.en: Mary Saunders, sat on a sharp slope high upon a corner block, elevated above a large garage and workshop space.
sentences.zh: 坐落在高处转角地块的陡坡上，俯瞰着下方的大型车库和工作室空间。

sentences.en: Hers was one of the last houses on the dead-end street, with three sides of the property backing onto dense bushland.
sentences.zh: 这是死胡同尽头的最后一栋房子之一，物业的三面都背靠着茂密的灌木丛。

sentences.en: Framed by lawns and native trees, a veranda wrapped around the length of the house, with a five-metre-high balcony providing the perfect spot to take in the scenic easterly views.
sentences.zh: 四周环绕着草坪和本土树木，一条游廊贯穿了房屋的全长，一个五米高的阳台是欣赏迷人东向景致的绝佳地点。

sentences.en: Senior Constable Rowley found William Tyrrell's mother, Angela, in a clear state of distress, walking down the middle of the street in tears.
sentences.zh: 高级警员罗利发现威廉·泰雷尔的母亲安吉拉显然情绪崩溃，泪流满面地走在马路中间。

sentences.en: Her husband Peter was frantically dashing around, calling William's name and checking the surrounding properties.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫彼得（Peter）则在慌乱地到处奔跑，呼喊着威廉的名字并检查周围的房屋。

sentences.en: The family at four had only arrived in Kendall at around nine the previous evening, after driving the roughly four-hour journey from their home in Sydney's northern beaches.
sentences.zh: 这个四口之家在前一天晚上九点左右才刚到达肯达尔，此前他们从悉尼北部海滩的家中驱车进行了大约四个小时的旅程。

sentences.en: Angela's father had recently passed away, and the purpose of the visit was to help her mother, Mary, organise her house for sale.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉的父亲最近刚刚去世，他们此行的目的是帮母亲玛丽收拾房子准备出售。

sentences.en: The substantial three-bedroom, two-bathroom house on a 1.2-acre block was simply too big for the elderly woman to look after on her own.
sentences.zh: 这栋面积1.2英亩、拥有三间卧室和两间浴室的宽敞房子对这位老太太来说独自照料实在太大了。

sentences.en: According to Angela, that morning of Friday,
sentences.zh: 据安吉拉回忆，2014年9月12日星期五的那个早晨，

sentences.en: September 12, 2014, the two Tyrrell children had woken up in good spirits.
sentences.zh: 泰雷尔家的两个孩子醒来时心情都很不错。

sentences.en: William and his four-year-old sister,
sentences.zh: 威廉和他四岁的姐姐林赛（Lindsay）

sentences.en: Lindsay, were excited to be at their grandmother's house, a place they had visited several times before.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能来到祖母的房子，这个地方他们以前已经拜访过好几次了。

sentences.en: Their father, Peter, had to make a video call for work, but the internet reception in Kendall was notoriously lousy, so he left the house at around 8.30am to make the call
sentences.zh: 他们的父亲彼得需要为工作进行视频通话，但肯达尔的网络信号出了名的糟糕，所以他在上午8点30分左右离开了家，

sentences.en: from the nearby town of Lakewood instead.
sentences.zh: 转而去附近的莱克伍德（Lakewood）镇打电话。

sentences.en: While Peter was gone,
sentences.zh: 在彼得离开期间，

sentences.en: William and Lindsay rode their bikes around Mary's driveway and explored the yard.
sentences.zh: 威廉和林赛在玛丽的车道上骑自行车，并在院子里探险。

sentences.en: Afterwards,
sentences.zh: 随后，

sentences.en: William played a game with his mother called Mummy Monster, which involved Angela chasing her son around the garden.
sentences.zh: 威廉和母亲玩了一个叫“木乃伊怪物”的游戏，内容是安吉拉在花园里追逐儿子。

sentences.en: When they were done, they climbed the steep slope back up to the house.
sentences.zh: 游戏结束后，他们爬上陡峭的斜坡回到了屋里。

sentences.en: The grass was covered in loose twigs and leaves and they kept slipping over.
sentences.zh: 草地上覆盖着散落的树枝和树叶，他们一直在滑倒。

sentences.en: One of the slips resulted in Angela injuring her hand, so they went inside to tend to the wound.
sentences.zh: 其中一次滑倒导致安吉拉的手受伤了，于是他们进屋去处理伤口。

sentences.en: Lindsay had heard them playing Mummy Monster and wanted to join in the game, so they went back outside for a while.
sentences.zh: 林赛听到他们玩“木乃伊怪物”也想加入游戏，所以他们又去外面玩了一会儿。

sentences.en: After the kids grew bored of that,
sentences.zh: 在孩子们对此感到厌烦之后，

sentences.en: William and Lindsay decided to make some cards to bring to their grandfather's grave when they visited later that day.
sentences.zh: 威廉和林赛决定制作一些卡片，准备当天晚些时候去拜访祖父的坟墓时带上。

sentences.en: Angela set them up with some art supplies on the back deck that overlooked the rear lawn.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉在俯瞰后院的后露台上为他们摆放好了一些美术用品。

sentences.en: Shortly after 9.30am, she grabbed her digital camera and snapped some photos of them.
sentences.zh: 上午9点30分刚过，她拿起数码相机给他们拍了几张照片。

sentences.en: William was thrilled that he'd been allowed to wear his new favourite outfit, a two-piece, blue and red
sentences.zh: 威廉很高兴自己能穿上他最喜欢的新衣服，那是一套两件套的蓝红相间的

sentences.en: Spider-Man costume that his parents had bought him on a recent family holiday to Bali.
sentences.zh: 蜘蛛侠服装，是父母最近带他去巴厘岛全家度假时买给他的。

sentences.en: He put a Spider-Man t-shirt underneath the polyester suit so he could be head-to-toe in his favourite superhero get-up.
sentences.zh: 他在聚酯纤维套装里面穿了一件蜘蛛侠T恤，这样他就能从头到脚都穿着自己最喜欢的超级英雄行头。

sentences.en: At 9.37am,
sentences.zh: 上午9点37分，

sentences.en: Angela stood above William and pointed the lens towards him as he crouched on the deck pretending to be a tiger.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉站在威廉上方，将镜头对准了他，当时他正蹲在露台上假装是一只老虎。

sentences.en: The little boy looked up at her, his eyes cast to the sky and mouth agape as he let out a loud roar.
sentences.zh: 小男孩抬头看着她，目光投向天空，嘴巴微张，发出一声响亮的吼叫。

sentences.en: It wasn't long before William lost interest in the craft session and began a new game he called
sentences.zh: 没过多久，威廉就对工艺制作失去了兴趣，并开始了一个他称之为

sentences.en: Daddy Tiger.
sentences.zh: “爸爸老虎”的新游戏。

sentences.en: This involved him crawling around and launching himself off the deck as he roared and clawed his hands in the air.
sentences.zh: 这需要他四处爬行，从露台上纵身跃下，同时发出吼叫并在空中挥舞双手。

sentences.en: He asked Lindsay to join in but she was too engrossed in the card-making process.
sentences.zh: 他邀请林赛加入，但她太专注于制作卡片的过程了。

sentences.en: William continued the game alone, ducking around the side of the house out of sight for a moment before reappearing with a loud roar.
sentences.zh: 威廉独自一人继续玩着游戏，一溜烟绕到房子侧面消失了一会儿，然后又伴随着一声大吼重新出现。

sentences.en: Just before 10am,
sentences.zh: 就在10点之前，

sentences.en: Angela said that she and her mother were sitting and watching the kids over a cup of tea.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉说她和母亲正坐在一起喝着茶看孩子们玩耍。

sentences.en: Mary remarked how loud William was being and Angela explained that's just how he was, always full of energy.
sentences.zh: 玛丽评论说威廉声音真大，安吉拉则解释说他就是这样，总是充满活力。

sentences.en: The two women looked on as William darted around the garden, jumping and roaring enthusiastically.
sentences.zh: 两个女人看着威廉在花园里飞奔，热情地蹦蹦跳跳、大声吼叫。

sentences.en: He then ran around the northwest corner of the house and out of sight, the sound of his roar still clearly audible.
sentences.zh: 接着他绕过了房子的西北角消失在视线之外，但他吼叫的声音依然清晰可闻。

sentences.en: After a few minutes,
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，

sentences.en: Angela noticed it had gone unusually quiet.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉注意到周围变得异常安静。

sentences.en: She got up and walked around the side of the house, but she couldn't see William anywhere.
sentences.zh: 她起身走到房子侧面，却到处都看不到威廉的身影。

sentences.en: Angela called out
sentences.zh: 安吉拉大声喊着

sentences.en: William's name, saying, where are you?
sentences.zh: 威廉的名字，说，你在哪儿？

sentences.en: I can't see you.
sentences.zh: 我看不见你。

sentences.en: There was no reply.
sentences.zh: 没有任何回应。

sentences.en: She looked for splashes of his red
sentences.zh: 她在生机勃勃的绿叶丛中寻找他那身红色的

sentences.en: Spider-Man costume against the vibrant green foliage, noting it was suddenly so quiet that even the bird seemed to have stopped chirping.
sentences.zh: 蜘蛛侠服装的踪迹，发现四周突然安静得连鸟儿似乎都停止了啼鸣。

sentences.en: Angela told Mary that she couldn't see William anywhere.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉告诉玛丽，她到处都看不到威廉。

sentences.en: Thinking he was hiding and playing a trick on them,
sentences.zh: 以为他在躲藏并跟他们开玩笑，

sentences.en: Mary remarked, oh, the little devil.
sentences.zh: 玛丽评价道，哦，这个小淘气。

sentences.en: But Angela was starting to get worried.
sentences.zh: 但安吉拉开始担心起来。

sentences.en: She went around the eastern side of the house and looked in the ferns that sat underneath the balcony, all the while calling William's name.
sentences.zh: 她绕到房子的东侧，查看阳台下方的蕨类植物，同时一直呼唤着威廉的名字。

sentences.en: When he didn't appear, she became frantic.
sentences.zh: 当他没有出现时，她变得慌乱起来。

sentences.en: Mary's property had no fence or other barrier to prevent William from wandering beyond its boundary.
sentences.zh: 玛丽的房产没有栅栏或其他屏障来阻止威廉走到边界之外。

sentences.en: Angela ran to the street, checking each side of the yard, but she still couldn't see or hear William.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉跑向街道，检查院子的每一侧，但她依然看不到也听不到威廉。

sentences.en: She ran into her mother's house, with Mary following, checking each room and opening cupboards to see if he was hiding inside.
sentences.zh: 她跑进母亲的房子，玛丽紧随其后，检查每一个房间并打开橱柜，看他是否藏在里面。

sentences.en: Angela tried to remain calm so that William wouldn't panic thinking he was in trouble.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉尽量保持冷静，以免威廉因为觉得自己惹上麻烦而惊慌失措。

sentences.en: Keeping her composure, she called,
sentences.zh: 她保持镇定，喊道：

sentences.en: William, you have to come out.
sentences.zh: “威廉，你得出来了。”

sentences.en: You have to talk to me.
sentences.zh: “你得跟我说话。”

sentences.en: No more hiding,
sentences.zh: “别再躲了，

sentences.en: William.
sentences.zh: 威廉。”

sentences.en: I can't see you.
sentences.zh: “我看不见你。”

sentences.en: There was no reply.
sentences.zh: 没有任何回应。

sentences.en: While all this was happening,
sentences.zh: 正当这一切发生的时候，

sentences.en: Angela's husband,
sentences.zh: 安吉拉的丈夫

sentences.en: Peter, had been at the
sentences.zh: 彼得，一直在

sentences.en: Lakewood shopping precinct, making his work calls from inside his brand new
sentences.zh: 莱克伍德购物区，坐在他崭新的

sentences.en: Land Rover Discovery.
sentences.zh: 路虎发现者车内打工作电话。

sentences.en: After stopping to grab a newspaper, he headed straight back to Kendall.
sentences.zh: 停下来买了一份报纸后，他直接驱车返回肯达尔。

sentences.en: Peter told the police that at around
sentences.zh: 彼得告诉警察，大约在

sentences.en: 10.30am, as he neared
sentences.zh: 上午10点30分，当他靠近

sentences.en: Benaroon Drive, he'd sent Angela a voice-to-text message suggesting it was a good time to send the kids outside.
sentences.zh: 本鲁恩路时，他给安吉拉发了一条语音转文字的信息，建议现在是让孩子们去外面玩的好时机。

sentences.en: William had a deep fascination with cars, trucks and planes, which was an interest
sentences.zh: 威廉对汽车、卡车和飞机有着深深的迷恋，这也是彼得

sentences.en: Peter encouraged.

sentences.zh: 麦当劳吃晚饭，并给孩子们换上了睡衣。

sentences.en: The unplanned nature of the trip ruled out the possibility that it was a targeted attack.
sentences.zh: 这次行程的临时性排除了这是一起有针对性的袭击的可能性。

sentences.en: As far as Peter and Angela were aware, no one had followed them on their drive from Sydney to
sentences.zh: 据彼得和安吉拉所知，他们从悉尼开车到

sentences.en: Kendall either.
sentences.zh: 肯德尔的路上也没有人尾随。

sentences.en: Police checked CCTV footage of their journey and the stops they'd made along the way, but found nothing to indicate the family was being trailed.
sentences.zh: 警方查看了他们行程的闭路电视监控录像以及沿途停留的画面，但没有发现任何迹象表明这家人被跟踪了。

sentences.en: The footage from their stopover at
sentences.zh: 他们在

sentences.en: McDonald's showed William joyfully riding into the restaurant on
sentences.zh: 麦当劳停留时的录像显示，威廉高高兴兴地坐在

sentences.en: Peter's shoulders, the very image of a happy family.
sentences.zh: 彼得的肩膀上走进餐厅，画面看起来分外温馨幸福。

sentences.en: Both William's foster parents and his biological parents were ruled out as suspects.
sentences.zh: 威廉的养父母和亲生父母最终都被排除在嫌疑人之外。

sentences.en: Regardless, the possibility that
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，调查人员依然很难理解

sentences.en: William could have been snatched in an opportunistic attack was difficult for investigators to comprehend.
sentences.zh: 威廉在一次随性袭击中被绑架的可能性。

sentences.en: Beneroon Drive was a safe place where none of the other residents had ever encountered anything untoward and children played on the street without fear.
sentences.zh: 贝纳鲁恩大道是一个安全的地方，其他居民从未遇到过任何不测，孩子们可以在街上玩耍而无需担惊受怕。

sentences.en: The isolated location of Mary Saunders' house at the end of the street, coupled with the lack of street traffic in the area, meant that a kidnapper
sentences.zh: 玛丽·桑德斯的房子位于街道尽头，位置偏僻，再加上该地区街上人烟稀少，这意味着绑架者

sentences.en: would have had to coincidentally walk or drive past in the mere minutes that
sentences.zh: 必须恰好在

sentences.en: William jumped around the side of the house unsupervised.
sentences.zh: 威廉无人看管地在房子侧面玩耍的那短短几分钟内，路过或开车经过。

sentences.en: Had such a rare moment occurred, it would have taken an incredibly brazen offender to snatch a child in broad daylight with his family just metres away, on a quiet
sentences.zh: 如果真发生了如此罕见的情况，那得是一个极其胆大妄为的罪犯，才敢在大白天、在距离家人仅几米远的一条安静街道上绑架儿童，

sentences.en: street, where any of the neighbours could have easily noticed an outsider.
sentences.zh: 而任何邻居本都可以轻而易举地注意到这个外人。

sentences.en: Several residents were home at the time, and all of them said they hadn't noticed anyone or anything out of the ordinary.
sentences.zh: 当时有好几位居民在家，他们都说没有注意到任何异常的人或事。

sentences.en: None of them had been expecting any visitors on the morning that William went missing either.
sentences.zh: 在威廉失踪的那个早晨，他们也没有预期会有任何人来访。

sentences.en: Still, police couldn't discount the possibility that someone could have dropped by without warning, seen William, and made the split-second decision to take him.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，警方还是无法排除这种可能性：有人不请自来，看到了威廉，然后瞬间作出了将他抱走的决定。

sentences.en: It was also possible that William had heard a car coming and ran onto the street thinking it was his father arriving home before being snatched.
sentences.zh: 还有一种可能是，威廉听到有车开过来，以为是爸爸回家了，便跑到街上，随后遭到了绑架。

sentences.en: However unlikely, investigators also theorised that someone could have heard the children playing earlier that morning and had lay in wait ready to strike if an opportunity arose.
sentences.zh: 尽管可能性不大，但调查人员还推测，可能有人当天清晨听到孩子们在玩耍，便潜伏在附近，等待时机伺机下手。

sentences.en: If so, they would have had to move incredibly faSt.
sentences.zh: 果真如此的话，他的动作必须快到难以置信。

sentences.en: The fact that William was wearing the distinct
sentences.zh: 威廉当时穿着标志性的

sentences.en: Spider-Man outfit would have made it easy for someone to initiate a conversation with him, as it was an immediate talking point that would have appealed to William.
sentences.zh: 蜘蛛侠服装，这会让人很容易与他搭话，因为这是一个能立即吸引威廉注意力的共同话题。

sentences.en: A perpetrator could have used that to lure the young boy away voluntarily, or simply grabbed him and forced his silence.
sentences.zh: 作案者可以利用这一点诱使小男孩自愿跟他走，或者直接抓住他并强行让他噤声。

sentences.en: According to Angela, when she first realised
sentences.zh: 据安吉拉回忆，当她第一次意识到

sentences.en: William went missing, she was struck by how silent everything had gone.
sentences.zh: 威廉失踪时，她被四周死一般的寂静深深震撼了。

sentences.en: Then, she thought she heard a short, high-pitched scream coming from the bushland.
sentences.zh: 随后，她自认听到丛林里传来一声短促而高亢的尖叫。

sentences.en: The type of scream a child would make if they'd hurt themselves.
sentences.zh: 那种小孩子受伤时会发出的尖叫。

sentences.en: Angela said she had ventured into the reeds towards the direction of the sound, but couldn't see any splashes of red from William's Spider-Man suit.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉说她曾朝着声音传来的方向深入芦苇丛，却没看到威廉的蜘蛛侠套装闪现任何红色的斑块。

sentences.en: She had brushed it off as her imagination, thinking it must have been a bird.
sentences.zh: 她没把这当回事，以为只是自己的幻觉，觉得那应该是一只鸟。

sentences.en: Kendall was home to a species of bird known as a cat bird, which makes a sound very similar to that of a crying child.
sentences.zh: 肯德尔镇栖息着一种名为猫鸟的鸟类，叫声与哭泣的小孩极为相似。

sentences.en: At the end of Benaroon Drive, a dirt fire track leads into the dense scrub.
sentences.zh: 在贝纳鲁恩大道的尽头，一条泥泞的防火小径通向茂密的灌木丛。

sentences.en: If the perpetrator had been on foot, this could have provided an escape route for them to grab William and run off undetected.
sentences.zh: 如果作案者是步行作案，这可能会为他们提供一条逃生路线，让他们能够带走威廉并在不被察觉的情况下逃跑。

sentences.en: But the terrain in the surrounding bush was rough, and running off with a three-year-old boy would have been no easy feat.
sentences.zh: 但周围灌木丛的地形崎岖不平，带着一个三岁的小男孩逃跑绝非易事。

sentences.en: If this was indeed a random, opportunistic attack, everyone agreed it would be one of the rarest and most unfortunate cases of William Tyrrell
sentences.zh: 如果这确实是一起随机的、临时起意的袭击，所有人都认同这将是威廉·泰瑞尔案中最罕见、最不幸的案例之一

sentences.en: being in the wrong place at the wrong time.
sentences.zh: 即在错误的时间出现在错误的地点。

sentences.en: When asked if anyone unusual lived in the area,
sentences.zh: 当被问及附近是否有行为异常的人时，

sentences.en: Mary Saunders pinpointed one person, a former taxi driver aged in his 50s who mostly kept to himself.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·桑德斯明确指出了一人，那是一名50多岁的退休出租车司机，平时独来独往。

sentences.en: While there wasn't anything overtly suspicious about him, he lived alone in a small house surrounded by bushland where he kept odd hours, typically sleeping during the day
sentences.zh: 虽然他身上并没有什么明显的形迹可疑之处，但他独自住在被灌木丛包围的小房子里，作息时间古怪，通常白天睡觉

sentences.en: and hanging around his house at night.
sentences.zh: 晚上则在屋子附近闲逛。

sentences.en: In the days following William Tyrrell's disappearance, some neighbours noticed that the taxi driver had uncharacteristically left his house.
sentences.zh: 在威廉·泰瑞尔失踪后的几天里，一些邻居注意到这位出租车司机一反常态地离开了家。

sentences.en: When he returned home a couple of days later, he was carrying a backpack and walked around his property as though checking each of his windows before going inside.
sentences.zh: 几天后他回到家中时，背着一个背包，在房产四周走动，似乎在进屋前检查了每一扇窗户。

sentences.en: An officer went to visit the former taxi driver and noticed something odd.
sentences.zh: 一名警员前去拜访这位前出租车司机，并注意到了一些奇怪的地方。

sentences.en: A box had been installed over one of his windows, making it impossible to see inside.
sentences.zh: 其中一扇窗户上安装了一个箱子，让人根本无法窥视屋内。

sentences.en: When questioned about his whereabouts on the day of William's disappearance, the taxi driver claimed he'd been sleeping at home alone, an alibi that couldn't be verified.
sentences.zh: 当被问及威廉失踪当天的行踪时，这名出租车司机声称自己当时独自在家睡觉，这个不在场证明无法得到证实。

sentences.en: The officer noted that the man had a small red mark on his wriSt.
sentences.zh: 警员注意到这名男子的手腕上有一个小红斑。

sentences.en: A cursory search of the property revealed a stepladder in the laundry that led up to a manhole.
sentences.zh: 对该房产的粗略搜查显示，洗衣房里有一把通往阁楼检修口的折叠梯。

sentences.en: The officer climbed to the ladder, wondering if the manhole could be used as a hiding place.
sentences.zh: 警员爬上梯子，盘算着这个检修口是否能被用作藏身之处。

sentences.en: But it was obvious the manhole hadn't been accessed in some time.
sentences.zh: 但很明显，这个检修口已经很久没有人使用过了。

sentences.en: When the police returned to visit the taxi driver again, his television had been paused on a news channel providing updates about William's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 当警方再次上门回访这名出租车司机时，他家的电视正暂停在一个播放威廉失踪最新进展的新闻频道上。

sentences.en: Although this indicated he was keeping an eye on the story, police found nothing to suggest he was involved in the crime in any way.
sentences.zh: 尽管这表明他一直在关注这起新闻，但警方并未发现任何证据表明他与这起案件有任何瓜葛。

sentences.en: The taxi driver soon sold his house and moved out of Kendall, saying there was too much activity in the area.
sentences.zh: 不久后，这名出租车司机卖掉了房子并搬离了肯德尔，称该地区的活动实在太多。

sentences.en: By day 14 of the hunt for William, line searchers had painstakingly covered an area of 18 square kilometres.
sentences.zh: 搜寻威廉的行动进入第14天，地毯式搜救人员已经一丝不苟地覆盖了18平方公里的区域。

sentences.en: Various items were found, including an abandoned children's cubby house, number plates from a stolen vehicle, animal bones, a shovel, a spear gun, and other miscellaneous iteMs.
sentences.zh: 搜寻出了各种物品，包括废弃的儿童游戏屋、被盗车辆的车牌、动物骨骼、一把铁锹、一把水下鱼枪和其他杂物。

sentences.en: But all of them were ruled out of having anything to do with William's disappearance, and still, there was no sign of him.
sentences.zh: 但所有这些都被排除与威廉的失踪有关，而且依然没有任何关于他的踪迹。

sentences.en: Investigators had no choice but to scale the search back.
sentences.zh: 调查人员别无选择，只能缩减搜寻规模。

sentences.en: Instead, they turned their focus to known sex offenders in the area.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们将重点转向了该地区有案底的性犯罪者。

sentences.en: This was no easy task.
sentences.zh: 这绝非易事。

sentences.en: Within the 30 kilometre radius of Benaroon Drive alone,
sentences.zh: 仅在以贝纳鲁恩大道为圆心的30公里半径范围内，

sentences.en: 18 known sex offenders lived among the rural properties.
sentences.zh: 就居住着18名知名的性犯罪者，他们散落于乡村住宅之间。

sentences.en: Just further beyond that lived another 60.
sentences.zh: 再往外围，还住着另外60名。

sentences.en: Detective Chief Inspector Gary Jubelin, who would later come to front
sentences.zh: 高级侦探总督察加里·朱贝林后来接手并领导了

sentences.en: Strikeforce Roseanne, remarked,
sentences.zh: 罗斯安妮专案组，他评论道：

sentences.en: It's as if they've settled on this quiet, overlooked backwater like mosquitoes.
sentences.zh: “他们就像蚊子一样，在这个安静、被忽视的偏远穷乡僻壤安顿了下来。”

sentences.en: Detective Jubelin told reporters that police intended to track the movements of everyone who was within a one kilometre radius of Benaroon Drive on the day William went missing.
sentences.zh: 朱贝林侦探告诉记者，警方打算追踪威廉失踪当天在贝纳鲁恩大道一公里半径范围内所有人员的行踪。

sentences.en: If anyone who had been in the area failed to come forward and identify themselves,
sentences.zh: 如果任何曾经身处该地区的人未能主动现身并表明身份，

sentences.en: Jubelin warned it would give the police grave concerns and be an immediate cause for suspicion.
sentences.zh: 朱贝林警告称，这将引发警方的高度关切，并成为立即产生怀疑的理由。

sentences.en: CCTV footage was collected from 12 businesses around Kendall.
sentences.zh: 警方调取了肯德尔周边12家企业的闭路电视监控录像。

sentences.en: Police were particularly interested in the footage captured by the Kendall Tennis Club between 5 and 11 on the morning of Friday,
sentences.zh: 警方对肯德尔网球俱乐部在2014年9月12日星期五

sentences.en: September 12, 2014.
sentences.zh: 早晨5点到11点之间捕获的监控画面尤为感兴趣。

sentences.en: This camera faced one of the main roads leading in and out of the village and there was a chance it had captured the abductor's car.
sentences.zh: 这个摄像头正对着通往村庄内外的干道之一，它很有可能拍下了绑架者的汽车。

sentences.en: However, the footage was grainy and only captured the sides of the vehicles, not their number plates, making it difficult to identify the cars that came and went.
sentences.zh: 然而，录像画面非常模糊，只能拍到车辆的侧面，无法拍到车牌，这使得识别来往车辆变得十分困难。

sentences.en: However,
sentences.zh: 不过，

sentences.en: there were numerous roads leading to Benaroon Drive and it was possible the kidnapper hadn't been captured on any cameras at all.
sentences.zh: 通往贝纳鲁恩大道的道路众多，绑架者也可能根本没有被任何摄像头拍到。

sentences.en: Although William Tyrrell's disappearance had made national headlines, investigative resources were limited and questioning witnesses and persons of interest
sentences.zh: 尽管威廉·泰瑞尔的失踪成了全国头条新闻，但调查资源有限，盘问证人和重点嫌疑人

sentences.en: was a time-consuming task.
sentences.zh: 是一项耗时费力的任务。

sentences.en: Police were also inundated with reported sightings of William coming from all over the country.
sentences.zh: 警方还被来自全国各地、声称目击到威廉的报告淹没。

sentences.en: It didn't help that Spider-Man costumes were incredibly popular amongst young boys.
sentences.zh: 蜘蛛侠服装在小男孩中极其流行，这毫无助益。

sentences.en: Every potential lead, sighting and piece of information was diligently recorded, but the hard part for police was figuring out which to prioritise.
sentences.zh: 每一条潜在的线索、目击情报和信息都被认真记录下来，但对警方来说最难的是弄清楚该优先处理哪一条。

sentences.en: They worked tirelessly for several months, checking 169 CCTV cameras from outside Kendall as well as analysing data from traffic cameras and mobile phone towers.
sentences.zh: 他们夜以继日地工作了几个月，检查了肯德尔市外169个监控摄像头，并分析了交通摄像头和手机基站的数据。

sentences.en: But things moved slowly and as the year drew to an end, they didn't seem to be any closer to finding William.
sentences.zh: 但案件进展缓慢，随着这一年接近尾声，他们似乎距离找到威廉并没有更近一步。

sentences.en: Then, a call came in from someone who wanted to report a member of the community as a potential person of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，警方接到了一通举报电话，有人想举报社区的一名成员作为潜在的重点嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Four days before William Tyrrell went missing, his grandmother Mary called a local white goods repair company called Speddo's Repairs after her washing machine stopped working.
sentences.zh: 在威廉·泰瑞尔失踪四天前，他的祖母玛丽因洗衣机坏了，给一家名为“斯佩多维修”的当地白色家电维修公司打了个电话。

sentences.en: The business owner,
sentences.zh: 店老板、

sentences.en: 63-year-old Bill Spedding, came to the house to provide a quote, only to discover that he needed to order a new part.
sentences.zh: 63岁的比尔·斯佩丁来到她家进行估价，结果发现需要订购一个新零件。

sentences.en: He told Mary he would come back to conduct the repairs whenever the part came in.
sentences.zh: 他告诉玛丽，等零件一到，他就会回来进行维修。

sentences.en: On Friday, September 12, just 90 minutes before William vanished,
sentences.zh: 9月12日星期五，就在威廉失踪前仅仅90分钟，

sentences.en: Angela had called
sentences.zh: 安吉拉代表她母亲

sentences.en: Bill Spedding on her mother's behalf to follow up on the replacement part as the washing machine still wasn't working.
sentences.zh: 给比尔·斯佩丁打了电话，催问更换零件的事，因为洗衣机仍然没修好。

sentences.en: The call had gone straight to voicemail, so she left a message asking Spedding to call her back.
sentences.zh: 电话直接转入了语音信箱，于是她留了一条言，要求斯佩丁回电。

sentences.en: Mary said that he would likely show up at any time without prior notice.
sentences.zh: 玛丽说他很可能会随时不请自来。

sentences.en: That's just how things were done in Kendal.
sentences.zh: 肯德尔一向都是这种行事风格。

sentences.en: Given that Bill Spedding was one of the few visitors to Benaroon Drive in the days leading up to William's disappearance, police had already taken him in for questioning
sentences.zh: 鉴于比尔·斯佩丁是威廉失踪前几天少数几个造访过贝纳鲁恩大道的人之一，警方在调查的早期阶段

sentences.en: in the early stages of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 就已经把他带去盘问过了。

sentences.en: Spedding had confirmed details about the initial repair call-out, but he denied having received a follow-up phone call from Angela on September 12.
sentences.zh: 斯佩丁证实了最初那次上门维修通话的细节，但他否认在9月12日接到过安吉拉的后续催问电话。

sentences.en: Police confiscated
sentences.zh: 警方没收了

sentences.en: Spedding's phone and found no record of Angela's voicemail.
sentences.zh: 斯佩丁的手机，却没有找到任何安吉拉的语音留言记录。

sentences.en: This was immediately suspicious.
sentences.zh: 这立刻引起了怀疑。

sentences.en: Police already had
sentences.zh: 警方已经掌握了

sentences.en: Angela's phone data confirming she had made the call to Bill Spedding, leaving officers to wonder if he had deleted it.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉的手机数据，证实她确实给比尔·斯佩丁打过电话，这让警员们不禁怀疑他是否将其删除了。

sentences.en: If he had nothing to do with
sentences.zh: 如果他与威廉的失踪无关，

sentences.en: William's disappearance, they wondered why he would do such a thing.
sentences.zh: 他们想不通他为什么要这样做。

sentences.en: But Bill Spedding steadfastly denied having ever received the message at all.
sentences.zh: 但比尔·斯佩丁坚决否认自己曾经收到过这条留言。

sentences.en: He also claimed to have an alibi for the day of William's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 他还声称自己有威廉失踪当天的绝对不在场证明。

sentences.en: According to Spedding, he and his wife Margaret had coffee at a local cafe, leaving around
sentences.zh: 据斯佩丁供述，他和妻子玛格丽特在当地一家咖啡馆喝咖啡，大约在

sentences.en: 9.45am to attend a school assembly where their grandson had received an award.
sentences.zh: 上午9点45分离开，去参加一个学校集会，他们的孙子在那里获得了颁奖。

sentences.en: Afterwards,
sentences.zh: 此后，

sentences.en: Spedding said he went back to his office and worked a normal day before picking his grandchildren up from school.

sentences.en: Having been sexually assaulted in a foster home during her own adolescence, the woman became an advocate for other foster children
sentences.zh: 由于自己在青春期曾在寄养家庭遭受性侵，这个女人成为了其他寄养儿童的倡导者，

sentences.en: and believed the public had a right to know the truth about William's family situation.
sentences.zh: 并认为公众有权知道威廉家庭情况的真相。

sentences.en: The case went to court where lawyers for the Department of Family and Community Services argued that there was a stigma attached to being a foster child.
sentences.zh: 案件闹上法庭，家庭和社区服务部的律师辩称，身为寄养儿童带有某种污名。

sentences.en: If William was ever found alive, this stigma would follow him for life.
sentences.zh: 如果威廉有一天被活着找到，这种污名将伴随他一生。

sentences.en: Likewise, his sister Lindsay would suffer from the same stigma.
sentences.zh: 同样，他的姐姐林赛也会遭受同样的污名。

sentences.en: William's foster parents agreed that they wanted to keep this information secret, along with their identities.
sentences.zh: 威廉的养父母同意他们希望将这些信息以及他们的身份保密。

sentences.en: Up until this point,
sentences.zh: 在此之前，

sentences.en: William's biological parents Amy Tyrrell and Tyler Martin had mostly been kept on the sidelines of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 威廉的亲生父母艾米·泰瑞尔和泰勒·马丁大多被排除在调查的边缘。

sentences.en: They didn't receive the same regular updates as his foster parents, weren't acknowledged in the media, and had been excluded from the national public relations campaign
sentences.zh: 他们没有像他的养父母那样定期收到最新消息，没有在媒体中得到承认，并被排除在旨在提高案件知名度的国家公共关系活动之外。

sentences.en: aimed at bringing awareness to the case.
sentences.zh: 旨在提高对该案的认识。

sentences.en: However, they had always wanted it to be publicly known that William was in foster care at the time he went missing.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们一直希望公众知道威廉在失踪时处于寄养状态。

sentences.en: The judge agreed that the public had been misled to believe that Peter and Angela were William Tyrrell's biological parents.
sentences.zh: 法官同意，公众一直被误导，以为彼得和安吉拉是威廉·泰瑞尔的亲生父母。

sentences.en: In a landmark decision, he lifted the restrictions that prevented this fact from being reported, ruling that William being in foster care
sentences.zh: 在一项具有里程碑意义的裁决中，他取消了阻止报道这一事实的限制，裁定威廉处于寄养状态

sentences.en: was a legitimate matter of public intereSt.
sentences.zh: 是一个合法的公众利益事件。

sentences.en: For the first time since William went missing, the names of his biological parents were allowed to be shared, while the names of his foster parents and sister
sentences.zh: 自威廉失踪以来，他的亲生父母的名字首次被允许分享，而他的养父母和姐姐的名字

sentences.en: continued to be suppressed by a court order.
sentences.zh: 继续受到法院命令的压制。

sentences.en: Afterwards, Amy Tyrrell appeared on national television for the first time.
sentences.zh: 随后，艾米·泰瑞尔首次出现在全国电视上。

sentences.en: In a heartfelt interview with television presenter Melissa Doyle for Channel 7's Sunday Night program, she admitted to having made poor choices in the past,
sentences.zh: 在为7号台《周日晚》节目接受电视主持人梅丽莎·多伊尔的真诚采访时，她承认过去曾做出过糟糕的选择，

sentences.en: but said she was trying to be the best mum she could be.
sentences.zh: 但表示她正在努力成为她所能成为的最好的妈妈。

sentences.en: No longer in a relationship with Tyler Martin,
sentences.zh: 与泰勒·马丁不再是情侣关系后，

sentences.en: Amy said William and Lindsay shouldn't have been taken away from her in the first place.
sentences.zh: 艾米表示，威廉和林赛本来就不应该被从她身边带走。

sentences.en: She believed the whole situation could have been improved if there had just been better support for mothers who were experiencing domestic violence.
sentences.zh: 她相信，如果对遭受家庭暴力的母亲有更好的支持，整个情况本可以得到改善。

sentences.en: Amy cried as she fondly recounted memories of William as a baby.
sentences.zh: 艾米哭着深情回忆起威廉作为婴儿时的记忆。

sentences.en: She spoke of how difficult the experience of losing him twice had been.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了再次失去他的经历是多么痛苦，

sentences.en: and how much it hurt her to know that William and Lindsay were no longer together.
sentences.zh: 一想到威廉和林赛再也不能在一起，她的心就痛得厉害。

sentences.en: Sobbing, she begged whoever had her son to bring him home unharmed, saying whoever was responsible, quote, needs a bullet.
sentences.zh: 她啜泣着恳求绑走她儿子的人把他完好无损地带回家，并说无论谁负有责任，“引用的话，该吃一颗子弹”。

sentences.en: Whatever had happened to William,
sentences.zh: 无论威廉发生了什么，

sentences.en: Amy believed that his foster parents should feel guilty.
sentences.zh: 艾米认为他的养父母应该感到内疚。

sentences.en: As police continued to make their way through the long list of persons of interest, when speaking with Kendall locals, one name in particular kept coming up.
sentences.zh: 随着警方继续排查长长的嫌疑人名单，在与肯德尔当地人交谈时，有一个名字经常被提起。

sentences.en: The individual lived a reclusive lifestyle in an overgrown property near Benaroon Drive and some people thought he was worth looking into.
sentences.zh: 这个人过着隐居的生活，住在贝纳鲁姆道附近一处杂草丛生的房产里，有些人认为他值得调查一番。

sentences.en: Police arrived at the man's house and what they found was disturbing.
sentences.zh: 警察来到这个男人的住所，发现的情况令人不安。

sentences.en: Outside, animal carcasses hung from pieces of string.
sentences.zh: 外面，动物尸体挂在绳子上。

sentences.en: Inside was even creepier.
sentences.zh: 里面则更加令人毛骨悚然。

sentences.en: At the end of the man's bed, a shrine of sorts had been made to William Tyrrell.
sentences.zh: 在这个男人的床头，供奉着一个类似于威廉·泰瑞尔的神龛。

sentences.en: It featured photos of William along with quotes about the investigation that had been cut from the newspaper as well as handwritten poetry about the case.
sentences.zh: 里面摆放着威廉的照片，以及从报纸上剪下的关于调查的引言，还有关于此案的手写诗歌。

sentences.en: Due to the man's unconventional lifestyle, police nicknamed him Gorillas in the Mist after the book and film of the same name about an American scientist
sentences.zh: 由于这个男人非传统的生活方式，警方给他起了一个绰号叫“迷雾中的大猩猩”，取自同名书籍和电影，讲述了一位美国科学家

sentences.en: who moved to the remote forests of Rwanda to study primates.
sentences.zh: 搬到卢旺达偏远森林研究灵长类动物的故事。

sentences.en: Police questioned Gorillas in the Mist extensively but found nothing to suggest he was involved in William's abduction.
sentences.zh: 警方对“迷雾中的大猩猩”进行了广泛的盘问，但没有发现任何迹象表明他参与了威廉的绑架。

sentences.en: If anything, they thought he seemed lonely and appreciated the police company.
sentences.zh: 如果说有什么不同的话，他们觉得他似乎很孤独，并很感激有警察作伴。

sentences.en: However, there were certain things about his behaviour that they deemed concerning.
sentences.zh: 然而，他的某些行为被他们认为令人担忧。

sentences.en: Not wanting to take any chances, the police decided to put Gorillas in the Mist under surveillance by installing hidden cameras in the bush surrounding his property.
sentences.zh: 为了稳妥起见，警方决定通过在他房产周围的灌木丛中安装隐藏摄像头来监视“迷雾中的大猩猩”。

sentences.en: Before long, one of the cameras went missing.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，其中一个摄像头就不见了。

sentences.en: Police had no idea what had happened to it until six weeks later when it suddenly reappeared under strange circumstances.
sentences.zh: 警方完全不知道它发生了什么，直到六周后它在奇怪的情况下突然重新出现。

sentences.en: To be continued.
sentences.zh: 未完待续。
